title: M5Q Native R3 optical-state qualification
evidenceScope: Research-only native qualification for the registered Architecture Rise GroundGlassWebGPUAdapter path.

nativeRuntime.environment: Headed native WebGPU Chrome on macOS

candidateSearch.screeningMode: Full32 expected-blur signal and geometry/support only; B0/B1 quality was not consulted.

Q1_Q5_Q6.reason: Largest Full32/source interior-far signal and largest measured uncapped raster radius.

Q2_Q7.reason: Meaningful far signal plus reconstructed-depth edge support.

Q3_Q4.reason: Selected despite fewer raster pairs than the 8,890 mm alternatives (540 versus 5,213/5,851) because its canonical façade CoC is +0.330761 mm versus +0.000517 mm near focus and its expected interior Full32/source signal is 0.004029 versus about 0.000086; the 4x 8,890 mm crop has zero reconstructed-depth edge pixels.

candidateSearch.fixtureEvidenceTreatment: Macro and Interior Phase J–L runs are reported separately as native-research-fixture evidence below. They do not execute the registered GroundGlassWebGPUAdapter and are not merged into the Architecture Rise app-adapter Q1–Q7 decisions.

fixtureNativeEvidence.executionPath: Existing Phase J–L WebGPURenderer fixture with its own TSL graph, canonical subject factories and optical fixtures; it does not mount GroundGlassWebGPUAdapter.

runtime.environment: Headed native WebGPU Chrome on macOS

phaseJ.scope: Canonical Macro, Interior Corner and Architecture Rise fixtures provide optical and B0/B1 reference observations. None activates the 12 px cap; these states do not qualify app-adapter M5 output.

phaseK.scope: The native fixture demonstrates crop-driven cap overrun and reports correspondence limitations; it is not an app-adapter Q5 qualification.

phaseL.scope: L-A passes the Phase L fixture's own frozen macro-crop criteria only. Its 12 px cap overrun is 0.335938 px; L-A is not an M5Q Q1–Q7 or registered-app-adapter pass.

candidateDisposition.relationshipToM5qCandidateSearch: The eight-state M5Q candidate ranking is exclusively the registered Architecture Rise application-adapter search in GROUND_GLASS_M5Q_CANDIDATE_CATALOG.json. Phase J/K optical and correspondence states and Phase L Macro crop candidates are separately rerun native fixture context; they were not ranked against M5Q Q1-Q7 thresholds and are not confirmatory M5Q states. Their own-phase dispositions are recorded below, preserving all evidence without pooling it into app-adapter qualification.

canonicalGeometryAndDepth.selectedQ3Q4CanonicalSigns: Known foreground/midground surface points are negative-CoC and façade/far surface points are positive-CoC under the independent canonical calculation.
canonicalGeometryAndDepth.rasterCorrespondence: Reconstructed raster samples at the reported teaching-point pixels had validity code 0; their stored physical values are not treated as valid signed raster CoC or exact canonical correspondence.
canonicalGeometryAndDepth.focusTargetRelationship: Architecture Rise teaching focus target is 10 mm in front of the canonical façade.
canonicalGeometryAndDepth.depthConfidence: Probe-only; no arbitrary per-pixel canonical sign confidence is inferred.
